essentiel:
Le discours indirect rapporte des paroles : He said (that) he was tired.
Après un verbe au passé, les temps reculent : present → prétérit, will → would, can → could.
Une question rapportée garde l’ordre sujet + verbe : She asked where I lived.

lignes: She said she had seen it.

blocs.consigne: « I like pizza », said Tom. → Tom said he … pizza.

blocs.texte: « Where do you live? » → She asked me where I lived. « Are you ready? » → He asked if I was ready.

blocs.erreur: On garde l’ordre de la question : « She asked where did I live ».
blocs.correction: Ordre affirmatif : She asked where I lived.

a_toi.consigne: « I will help you. » → She said she … help me.

options: He asked me what time it was.
He asked me what time was it.
He asked me what time is it?
a_toi.reponse: He asked me what time it was.

a_toi.consigne: « Do you like jazz? » → He asked … I liked jazz.
